runs.name: H World Group Limited; Nasdaq HTHT ADSs and HKEX 1179; a multi-brand hotel franchisor, manager and lessee mostly in China with Deutsche Hospitality in Europe; formerly China Lodging and Huazhu; Hilton, Marriott and Atour read
runs.entry: Price **US$44.17 per ADS** (close 2026-10-13, Nasdaq; aggregator quote, flagged; US$4.417 per ordinary share, one ADS to ten shares; the Hong Kong line 1179 not used). Shares **3,154,059,870 ordinary = 315,405,987 ADS** (interim report furnished on 6-K 2026-09-23, accession 0001104659-26-109789, 3,233,044,130 issued less 78,984,260 treasury at 2026-06-30; the 20-F cover's 3,071,525,690 at 2025-12-31 checked against issued less treasury and `cover_shares.py`; the rise is the US$499.6M of 2026 convertible notes converted into 13M ADSs, less Q2 2026 repurchases); cap **US$13,931.5M**, RMB 93,757M at the PBOC central parity 6.7298. Sovereign **2.06%** (RMB 30-year, the Ministry of Finance curve as published by ChinaBond, its compiler, 2026-10-14; the MOF's own page dead on four tries; no RMB row in the protocol's table or `tools/sources.py`). Filings read: 20-F FY2025 (0001104659-26-048058), the 20-Fs FY2023, FY2021, FY2019 and FY2017 for the span, the Q1 and Q2 2026 results 6-Ks, the interim report 6-K, the AGM materials and results 6-Ks, the bond 6-Ks of September 2026; operating cash 2025 RMB 8,379M on the filed statement against the XBRL fact, agrees. `tools/run.py` refused the name (no RMB source, will not convert a USD quote for an RMB earner); every figure taken from the filed 20-Fs by hand. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 4.B, 3.D and 5 (the brief's departure). Rivals: the 20-F names BTG Hotels, Jinjiang, Atour, Marriott, InterContinental, Accor and Hilton; Hilton, Marriott and Atour read from their filings, BTG, Jinjiang and Accor flagged as not SEC filers, IHG files and was not taken. Deutsche Hospitality's euro earnings carried in RMB as filed at the RMB rate, a CONVENTION of the run (its five-year adjusted EBITDA below zero). **Q1 IN**: mostly a franchisor, 12,858 hotels at 2025-12-31, 573 leased or owned, fees about 3% to 6.5% of a franchised hotel's gross revenue; China and the Cayman structure ask for a lower price, not a pass (the analyst notes the doubt rule could have closed it here). **Q2 IN, narrowly**: legacy Huazhu decides, RMB 23,890M of 2021 to 2025 adjusted EBITDA against legacy DH's loss of RMB 144M; for, the fee business held through COVID (RMB 3,342M, 3,136M, 4,404M 2019 to 2021), 73% of room nights to loyalty members, 77% through own channels, 311M H Rewards members; against, same-hotel RevPAR down in seven of eight quarters of 2024 to 2025 and (3.0)% in Q2 2026, rates set against local rivals, the bottom of the fee band from about 5% to 3%, Atour from 1,210 to 2,015 hotels in two years. **Q3 FOR**: little capital of its own needed; the capital put in, chiefly Deutsche Hospitality at RMB 5,060M in 2020, earned nothing. **Q4 no STOP, WEIGHS AGAINST**: ten balance sheets read; adjusted EBITDA excluding stock pay featured in every release, revenue guidance raised August 2026; goodwill and intangibles RMB 10.5bn against equity of 13.0bn. **Q5 integrity IN, ability FOR**. **Q6 WEIGHS AGAINST on both parts**: Part A, Deutsche Hospitality bought for cash returned nothing, buyback programmes name no price, the largest purchases at about US$44 per ADS in 2026 above the bottom of the range, repurchases mostly absorbing issuance (3,112M shares 2022, 3,154M June 2026, the 2026 convertible converted at US$41.72); no all-stock deal, so the STOP does not apply; Part B, the 2023 options of the founder and the CEO struck about 24% below market, the founder alone on the committee granting below board level. Owner cash (operating cash less stock pay, all capex, finance-lease principal and minority dividends, RMB M) 1,646 / (1,313) / (474) / 378 / 6,546 / 6,229 / 7,060 (2019 to 2025), literal five-year mean **3,948** (pre-interest 3,992); 2021 aberrational on the filer's own COVID words, so the base is the 2019 to 2023 cycle average, **1,507** pre-interest (equity-only 1,357; the cycle's years a CONVENTION of the run, 2018 to 2023 beside at 1,574); purchases RMB 6,103M against 7,535M of owner cash before purchases in the window, so the organic pair is central at 10.61% a year (legacy Huazhu revenue 2019 to 2025, a CONVENTION of the run), the default pair beside (base 286); net cash RMB 6,621M after the September dividend (operating leases RMB 27.0bn left out, said so); enterprise value RMB 87,135M. **Q7 OUT**: no case earns the floor at the price (central organic growth case 4.2%, literal window no-growth 4.6%, default pair 2,865M worth at ten percent); central value range, organic pair, all-equity, **US$37.59 to 91.53 per ADS** (US$3.759 to 9.153 per ordinary share, RMB 25.29 to 61.60) at the 2.06% RMB 30-year, the price inside it, width 2.4 to 1; a post-COVID sensitivity, COMPUTATION NOT A CLEARANCE and no case of the range, returns 9.6% at the price, 10.1% with the filer's growth capex added back. Fair price central all-equity **US$14.08 per ADS** (US$1.408 per ordinary share), equity-only US$9.87 per ADS (US$0.987). Facts after the stop, not weighed: borrowings RMB 4,226M at 2026-06-30 plus the CNY 3,350M 2.25% bonds due 2031; finance leases RMB 2,993M; RMB 1,406M of cash pledged; rent RMB 4,179M in 2025 (16.5% of revenue); covenant waivers obtained in 2020 to 2021; a 2026 funding-support undertaking for a REIT unit repurchase of about RMB 1,239M; RMB 4,269M of PRC net assets not distributable; the PCAOB and HFCA Act risk. Q12: nothing the rows name. Contamination declared by the analyst: the H fold commit subjects in its session context, not used; a `Test Runs/` listing filtered to 2026-10-14, made to check its own file name, showed the names of the CHH, H, HGV, HLT, MAR, WH and four steel runs, none opened (a blind-rule breach, declared); write-early partly breached, the first commit after the first fetches, declared. Commits 4c3db4ef, 8635da0a, e40f022b, 06ca440f, 979a906a, 5081c94a, 750815d3, 1800e6fe, d918fc3d. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's check clean (90 ids by its count); the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 77 ids, 32 quoted cites, no missing id, no E-id, one slip: at Q6 "has nothing to do with preventing dilution" beside **[M2016-049]**, whose row reads "It's got nothing to do with preventing dilution" (the sense kept, the words not the row's), recorded here and not fixed in the run file. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) specific (a) with only one cycle in the filings, so growth between successive cycle averages cannot be measured, and no way to scale a cycle base across a structural shift (the choice swings the fair price from about US$14 to about US$38 per ADS, not the box); (2) whether both peak years sit in a peak-to-peak average; (3) the serial-acquirer rule triggered by one deal (Deutsche Hospitality 83% of the window's purchases); (4) no RMB row in the sovereign table or `tools/sources.py`, the MOF page dead, and at a 2.06% rate the range at the sovereign sits far above every case valued at the floor; (5) `tools/run.py` cannot take a USD-quoted ADS for an RMB earner. Could not get: profit by business model, a test of past guidance against outcome.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 after Q1 IN (mostly a franchisor, 12,858 hotels, 573 leased or owned; China and the Cayman structure asking a lower price), Q2 IN narrowly (legacy Huazhu decides at RMB 23,890M of five-year adjusted EBITDA against legacy DH's RMB 144M loss; fees held through COVID, 73% of nights to members, 77% direct; against, same-hotel RevPAR down in seven of eight quarters of 2024 to 2025, the fee band's bottom from about 5% to 3%, Atour 1,210 to 2,015 hotels), Q3 for (little capital; Deutsche Hospitality's RMB 5,060M earned nothing), Q4 no STOP with adjusted EBITDA against, Q5 integrity IN and ability for, Q6 against on both parts (unpriced buybacks absorbing issuance at about US$44 per ADS; options struck about 24% below market). Owner cash RMB 3,948M literal mean 2021 to 2025, but 2021 aberrational, so the 2019 to 2023 cycle average RMB 1,507M is the base, organic pair central at 10.61%; net cash RMB 6,621M. Value US$37.59 to 91.53 per ADS at the 2.06% RMB 30-year, the price US$44.17 inside it, no case earning the floor (4.2% central, 4.6% literal window; a post-COVID sensitivity 9.6%); fair US$14.08 per ADS all-equity (US$9.87 equity-only), alert armed. One citation slip recorded. Framework gaps for the operator: one cycle and a structural shift under specific (a); peak-to-peak years; the serial-acquirer rule on one deal; no RMB sovereign row; `tools/run.py` and a USD-quoted ADS of an RMB earner.
